text:
𝗡𝗔𝗦𝗘𝗘𝗥 𝟳/𝟭𝟱𝟭 𝗢𝗡 𝗗𝗘𝗕𝗨𝗧! 🔥🇦🇫

Naseer Khan took 7 wickets on Test debut, joint-most for an Afghan.
Zimbabwe made 339; Taylor 119.
Afghanistan were 143/5 chasing 418 at Day 4 stumps.

Can they pull it off? 👇

#AFGvZIM #Cricket

facebook.caption:
𝗡𝗔𝗦𝗘𝗘𝗥 𝗞𝗔 𝗗𝗘𝗕𝗨𝗧 𝗗𝗛𝗔𝗠𝗔𝗞𝗔! 🔥🇦🇫

👉 Naseer Khan ne Test debut mein 7/151 liye (44 over)
👉 Afghanistan ke liye debut par joint-most wickets, Ziaur Rahman ke barabar
👉 Zimbabwe 339 — Brendan Taylor 119, Kaia 96
👉 Day 4 stumps: Afghanistan 143/5, jeet ke liye 275 run baaki

Kya Afghanistan 418 chase kar paayega? Comment karo 👇

#CricketKiBaat #AFGvZIM #Cricket
